name: How long does it take to remove and replace a door threshold?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove and replace a door threshold?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to remove and replace a door threshold can range from 1 to 4 hours for a single standard threshold, assuming no significant complications. This includes the time for careful removal, surface preparation, and installation of the new threshold. More complex situations, such as integrated thresholds, extensive subfloor damage, or custom threshold fabrication, can extend the duration. It's best to discuss the specific timeline with your contractor during the initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Removing and replacing a door threshold typically takes 1 to 4 hours for a standard job, but can be longer for complex situations.
